h:
使用 RealVisXL V5.0 的高质量 ComfyUI 工作流程，并通过 ControlNet 深度预处理和 4 倍 UltraSharp 升级进行增强。

🎯 主要特点：

- 🧠 型号：realvisxlV50_v50Bakedvae.safetensors

- 📐 控制网络：扩散_pytorch_model_promax.safetensors使用深度任意预处理器

- 🔍 升级器：4x-UltraSharp.pth

- 🔁 采样器：dpmpp_2m_sde与卡拉斯调度程序

- ⚙️ 去噪强度：0.7

- 🖼️输出分辨率：512x512（然后升级）

🧩 此工作流程使用：

- comfyui_controlnet_aux用于预处理

- ComfyUI-易于使用对于用户友好的节点

- ComfyUI-Crystools用于额外的公用事业

- rg Three 的 ComfyUI 节点用于高级提示和模型控制

提示示例：“梦幻般的柔和海滩、简约美学、加州海岸氛围、柔和的灯光、宁静的日落、粉色和橙色的天空、优雅的构图、光反射、海洋背景、美学摄影、柔软的沙子纹理、复古夏日色调、Fujifilm XT3、RAW 照片、高品质、8k uhd、单反相机、胶片颗粒”

负面提示：“（虹膜变形、瞳孔变形、半写实、cgi、3d、渲染、素描、卡通、绘画、动画）、文本、水印、徽标、裁剪、出框、低质量、jpeg 伪像、模糊、画得不好的手、画得不好的脸、突变、不良解剖结构、额外的肢体、融合的手指、UnrealisticDream”

o.en:
A high-quality ComfyUI workflow using RealVisXL V5.0, enhanced with ControlNet Depth preprocessing and 4x UltraSharp upscaling.

🎯 Main Features:

- 🧠 Model:realvisxlV50_v50Bakedvae.safetensors

- 📐 ControlNet:diffusion_pytorch_model_promax.safetensorsusingDepthAnythingPreprocessor

- 🔍 Upscaler:4x-UltraSharp.pth

- 🔁 Sampler:dpmpp_2m_sdewithKarrasscheduler

- ⚙️ Denoising strength:0.7

- 🖼️ Output resolution:512x512(then upscaled)

🧩 This workflow uses:

- comfyui_controlnet_auxfor preprocessing

- ComfyUI-Easy-Usefor user-friendly nodes

- ComfyUI-Crystoolsfor extra utilities

- rgthree's ComfyUI Nodesfor advanced prompt and model control

Example prompt:"dreamy pastel beach, minimalist aesthetic, california coastal vibes, soft lighting, serene sunset, pink and orange sky, elegant composition, light reflections, ocean background, aesthetic photography, soft sand texture, vintage summer tones, Fujifilm XT3, RAW photo, high quality, 8k uhd, dslr, film grain"

Negative prompt:"(deformed iris, deformed pupils, semi-realistic, cgi, 3d, render, sketch, cartoon, drawing, anime), text, watermark, logo, cropped, out of frame, low quality, jpeg artifacts, blurry, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn face, mutation, bad anatomy, extra limbs, fused fingers, UnrealisticDream"
